strings: m_c has seemed more sluggish then {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} clanmates, less energetic. Less focused on the reality and more lost in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} thoughts.
Sometimes m_c struggles to even get out of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nest in the mornings, weighed down by a heavy air in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} heart.
r_c wonders why m_c won't play with anyone, and they try to become friends and play with {PRONOUN/m_c/object}. m_c agrees to play with them, but don't seem too energetic about it.
m_c hides from {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} denmates, much to the concern of r_c as they curl around {PRONOUN/m_c/object}, they couldn't do much but purr in an attempt to comfort {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.

r_c is brought to the nursery by a worried parent, m_c wasn't running around and playing like the other kits, just curled in a ball staring blankly at the wall. After some gentle talking with m_c, r_c sits back and softly explains {PRONOUN/r_c/subject} {VERB/r_c/think/thinks} it's major depressive disorder.
